digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI on mirror main branch
propositions: Cancelled runs on main render as red X on healthy commits because push triggers with concurrency groups cancel superseded runs; removing push-on-main triggers and running CI on schedule eliminates this misreporting.

Six workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, terraform-drift.yml) trigger on push to main and must be converted to schedule-only for main-branch health reporting.
Scheduled main CI runs every 6 hours at staggered off-the-hour minutes (41/47/53) to signal current main state rather than per-commit truth, matching Chromium and OpenStack post-merge practices.
A red scheduled run must publish a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe with the last-known-green SHA and last-red SHA to enable fast binary-search remediation over the multi-commit window.
Pre-merge gating via Gerrit's Verified lane remains unchanged and unaffected because it runs through gerrit-verify.yaml's workflow_dispatch, which is decoupled from test.yml's trigger changes.
Non-main branch push CI is preserved by explicitly adding main to branches-ignore in four workflows while keeping topic-branch detection intact for continued per-branch validation.
